artifacts.summary: check_certificate's accepting branch now constructs a term of WitnessFamily.Refutes rather than reporting four decisions, with the distinction carried additively on the wire as "acceptance":"entailment".

completion_data.completion_summary: Made check_certificate's accepting branch proof-producing: added WitnessFamily.Certifies, decidableCertifies, Refutes and refutes_of_certifies to the library, and refutes_of_countermodel plus a dependent CheckOutcome/checkCertified/erase layer to BimodalTools.CertificateImport, so acceptance is a constructed entailment rather than a verdict about four Decidable instances. Extended the output contract with an additive "acceptance" key (absent reads as "decided") and corrected every in-repo trust-model disclaimer to the accurate build-time-implication claim. Full lake build green, zero sorries, no new axioms, and the real binary's rejected/error lines are byte-identical.
